coverage_explanation: Tests elapsed-second display, the 60-second alarm and its approximately one-second duration, continued counting after the alarm, pause stability, resume without clearing, clearing while paused, and restarting after clearing. Timing windows allow normal debounce and display refresh latency.
assumptions: Uses the disclosed bench defaults: D2 and D3 buttons connect to GND and use INPUT_PULLUP, with LOW meaning pressed.
The timer initially has a zero count and is paused, consistent with D2 being used to start timing.
The buzzer frequency is unspecified; any audible carrier is accepted.
Clearing is tested while paused, avoiding imposing an unspecified rule about whether clearing a running timer also pauses it.
Subsecond retention during pause is unspecified; display checks allow either retaining or discarding the fractional second.
